About ACIEL

A network to grow together

ACIEL is a non-profit association based in Luxembourg. It brings together the Spanish scientific and research community in the country: researchers, lecturers, innovation and knowledge-transfer professionals, science entrepreneurs and science communicators.

Our missionTo connect, represent and showcase the community of Spanish scientists, researchers and innovation professionals in Luxembourg, supporting their integration and professional development, promoting the visibility of Spanish science and innovation, and acting as a bridge for scientific, technological and institutional cooperation between Luxembourg, Spain and Europe, with a positive contribution to the scientific ecosystem and to Luxembourg society.

We act with political, institutional and financial independence, and we promote equality, inclusion and diversity.

Community and welcome

Gatherings and networking, plus welcome and guidance for people arriving in Luxembourg.

Professional development

Mentoring, workshops and seminars for the professional and personal development of our members.

Visibility and outreach

Communication and outreach to make Spanish science and innovation known in Luxembourg.

Cooperation and science diplomacy

Partnerships with universities, research centres, institutions, companies and sister associations in Luxembourg, Spain and Europe.

Our goals for the first year

  1. Build a communityBring the Spanish scientific community together and help people get to know each other.
  2. Gain visibilityGive Spanish science in Luxembourg a voice and a presence.
  3. Secure institutional and financial supportWork with the Embassy, institutions and companies.
  4. Sound, transparent governanceAn orderly structure, clear accounts and decisions shared with members.

Our pillars

  • Community
  • Representation
  • Integration and welcome
  • Professional development
  • Outreach and public visibility
  • International cooperation
  • Local impact

Becoming an ACIEL member

Member benefits

Available now

  • Professional networkAccess to a network of Spanish scientists and researchers at Uni.lu, LIST, LIH, LISER, LNS and other institutions in Luxembourg.
  • Welcome and guidancePractical guidance for those joining Luxembourg's research system.
  • Community gatheringsParticipation in ACIEL's gatherings and activities, starting with the first gathering on 3 December 2026.
  • Involvement in the associationThe opportunity to propose and coordinate activities, join working groups and, for full members, vote at the General Assembly.

In development

  • Mentoring and trainingMentoring programme and workshops on scientific careers and funding (ERC, MSCA, FNR).
  • Professional opportunitiesFunding calls, fellowships and job offers shared with members.
  • Newcomers' guidePractical information on research and life in Luxembourg.
  • VisibilityResearcher profiles and science outreach activities.

Become a member

Be one of ACIEL's first members

ACIEL has just been founded. Join now and you will not only be part of the community: you will help decide what we do and how we do it.

  • Meet other Spanish scientists and researchers in Luxembourg.
  • Get the invitation to our first community gathering on 3 December.
  • Suggest activities and join a working group.
  1. Fill in the form
  2. The Board reviews your application
  3. We welcome you

Members of Spanish nationality vote at the General Assembly; others can join as associate members. The annual fee is set by the General Assembly and we will let you know before any payment.
